notes.title: Update v 0.1.5 - Some improvements
notes.content:
I was focusing to work on the Player and the Mutants.
There I was reworking and changing the animation, the behavior and the modell.

From now on the head and arms of the mutants can be smashed.

Player:
I reworked the animations. 
Especially the animation when using the iron bolt.
I also changed the Players modell and design.

Mutants:
While I was working on the Player I also worked on the Mutants.
So, I also changed the mutants modell.
And i reworked the animation of the mutants.

Items:
Some Items my cause damage to the player and the NPCs.
Like Fire, Barbe Wire, Nuclear Water, ...

notes.title: Update v 0.1.4 - Today a larger update is coming. I hope you enjoy it.
notes.content:
[u]Map:[/u]
[list]
[*] The map has been completely redessigned.
[*] The view and the view angle on the map have been changed.
[*] The zoom function is now available with the mouse wheel.
[*] The traders and quests are now visible on the map.
[*] Added a legend on the map.
[/list]

[u]Weapons:[/u]
[list]
[*] A new melee weapon is available, the Iron Bolt. It is still available after death and cannot be dropped.
[/list]

[u]Controls:[/u]
[list]
[*] The keyboard controls have been expanded.
[*] Added zoom function for the map.
[*] The button for the Iron Bolt has been added.
[/list]

[u]Generally[/u]
[list]
[*] The currency symbol for the Micro Scraps has been edited.
[*] All levels have been made available as blueprint maps. The maps can be found in front of the exit of the first city.
[*] Safehouses are marked on the blueprint maps. Don't forget to buy the houses before you get on the journey.
[/list]

[u]Day and night cycle:[/u]
[list]
[*] The day and night cycle has been adjusted. The night now goes until 6:00 a.m.
[/list]

[u]Sleeping:[/u]
[list]
[*] From now on you can sleep in the bed in the Safehouse at night. Before you can sleep in the bed it must be set as respawn point.
[/list]

[u]Mutant Horde:[/u]
[list]
[*] Hordes now roam the levels.
[*] The hordes listen to noises. Sneaking around the horde helps.
[*] The hordes difficulty can be changed with the set Game difficulty settings.
[/list]

[u]Models:[/u]
[list]
[*] I optimized the models to get better run-time performance.
[/list]

notes.title: update 0.1.3
notes.content:
[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
You thought you are the hunter? Now the hunter is coming for you!
Fences of the Safehouse are now destroyable.
From now on the Base must be defended.
And don't forget to repair the fences.
From time to time a Mutant is coming for you especialy if your at your Safehouse.
His coming for you and your home.
[list]
[*] Added destroyable Fences from house
[*] Repairable Fences from home
[*] Some Mutants from now on hunts you and your home.
[*] Settings allow to adjust frequency when hunters come for you. At the moment only on the second level.
[/list]

notes.title: update 0.1.2
notes.content:
[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] The Minimap can be disabled in the settings.
[*] "Nightwalkers", the mutants that only wake up at night have been rebalanced.
[*] Nightwalkers aggressiveness has been reduced.
[*] The spawning behavior of Nightwalkers has been reduced.
[*] Changes to NPCs and NPCs behavior have been adjusted in various cities.
[*] Adjusted mutant locations and spawn behavior.
[*] The quest dialogues have been expanded if the quests are not yet accepted.
[/list]

[u]Bugfix:[/u]
[list]
[*] Some dialogs freezed at the end and only continued after pressing ESC.
[/list]

notes.title: small update 0.1.1
notes.content:
[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Optimized and reduced enemy spawning (in second level).
[*] Increased stamina when running.
[*] Reduced prices all Weapons.
[*] Optimized performance an several models.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] After dying and starting a new game, loot only became available again after completely restarting the game.
[*] In some cases, the safe was not saved after the player died and continued the game.
[*] In some cases, a weapon could no longer be equipped after the player died and continued the game.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: - Optimized and reduced enemy spawning (in second level).

tags.bug: - After dying and starting a new game, loot only became available again after completely restarting the game.
